svg.title: Matches Are Not for Children!! British Columbia Forest Service poster F. P. 19, reconstruction
svg.desc: A vector reconstruction drawn from one supplied photograph: yellow, orange and red paint with a white reserve, a gallows made of matches with a match figure hanging from it, the headline in dark hand-drawn capitals, the Forest Service oval seal, and the Canadian centennial mark and captions for 1966 and 1967. Every shape and letter is a path, with no embedded image or external font. The paint is simplified for the web from the reconstruction master. Details and colours are interpreted, not a verified archival facsimile.
